en.t: In front of the road, there was a small ditch.

units.source_text: 两个年幼的孩子，像姐弟俩，惊慌失措地从沟里爬出来。

en.t: Two young children, like an older sister and younger brother, scrambled out of the ditch in a panic.
By the time he noticed them, it was already too late.

units.source_text: 他侧面避开绳索，已经倾其全力了。

en.t: He had already used all his strength just dodging the rope to the side.

units.source_text: 于是，三人撞在一起滚翻下去。

en.t: So the three of them collided and tumbled down together.

units.source_text: 沟底有一根水管似的东西，发出木板碎裂的沉闷声音。

en.t: At the bottom of the ditch there was something like a water pipe, and it made a dull sound like wooden boards splitting apart.

units.source_text: 孩子们哼哼呀呀哭起来……妈的，怎么回事，光知道哭喊！

en.t: The children began whimpering and crying... Damn it, what was going on, all they knew how to do was scream and cry!

units.source_text: ……他使劲甩开孩子，正要往上爬时，三道手电光，一字儿排开，挡住了去路。

en.t: ...He forcefully shook the children off and was just about to climb up when three flashlight beams lined up in a row and blocked his way.
